title: Plan your trip – Destination Wairarapa
lines: We’re located right in the centre of New Zealand, making it easy to get to Wairarapa. At the heart of the Classic New Zealand Wine & Food Trail on SH2, we’re not far from Wellington and Palmerston North. Drive, train, bus, or jump on a guided tour, here’s how you can get to Wairarapa.
We've put together some suggested itineraries of must-do experiences to help you plan your visit here. You can also contact our friendly isite team here to book your visit.

At the heart of SH2, drive from Wellington over the Remutaka Hill and down into Wairarapa. It’s just over a 1 hour drive to Featherston. Continue on for another 15 minutes to Greytown or Martinborough. 20 minutes to Carterton or 40 minutes to Masterton. ​
Coming from Palmerston North? It’s a 1.5 hour drive via Pahiatua to Masterton.

Trains connect Wellington with Featherston, Woodside (Greytown), Carterton and Masterton, then catch a connecting bus to Martinborough or Greytown (weekdays only). See the Wellington to Wairarapa train timetable.
Book a shuttle from Wellington with the operators below. An Intercity coach service runs between Masterton and Palmerston North via Woodville. Take a look at the Intercity Coach timetable.
